summary: Creates a normal map from image edges for bump/normal mapping workflows with Phong MAT, PBR MAT, and related material pipelines.

key_params.name: source
key_params.note: luminance, rgba channels, rgbaverage, or average edge source

key_params.name: method
key_params.note: prevcur, curnext, or prevnext slope calculation

key_params.name: offset
key_params.note: Sample step components offset1 and offset2

key_params.name: heightmap
key_params.note: Store height map information in alpha

common_gotchas: Input contrast and noise strongly affect generated normals.
Sample step must match feature scale; too small or too large a step gives weak or chunky normals.
Enabling heightmap changes alpha output expectations downstream.
Downstream materials may require a specific normal-map Y orientation.
The label Sample Step maps to official parameter id offset.
key_concepts: Creates normal maps from image edge slopes.
Intended for bump or normal mapping workflows with Phong MAT or PBR MAT.
The source menu selects which input channel or average drives edge extraction.
The method menu chooses previous/current, current/next, or previous/next slope sampling.
Optional height map output stores height data in alpha.
